attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 4,486.19 million for the quarter and Rs. 9,134.94 million for the half-year. Net profit was Rs. 90.57 million for the quarter and Rs. 177.48 million for the half-year. Basic earnings per share was Rs. 0.89 for the quarter and Rs. 1.74 for the half-year. Total assets stood at Rs. 12,682.28 million as of September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and limited review reports were issued by D C Dharewa & Co.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding IPO proceeds utilization. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report. The IPO raised Rs 4,928.80 million. Net proceeds were Rs 3,629.38 million. Utilization is as per the Offer Document. No deviations were observed. Rs 1,635.00 million for prepayment of borrowings was fully utilized. Rs 778.28 million remains unutilized for capital expenditure. Rs 477.28 million for general corporate purposes was fully utilized. Rs 21.39 million remains unutilized for issue expenses. Unutilized funds are invested in Fixed Deposits with HDFC Bank. The company purchased commercial vehicles and containers differing from the prospectus due to market conditions. This is consistent with stated objects.

attchmntText: Western Carriers (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Western Carriers India Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 12:00 Noon IST. The management will discuss operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Mr. Kanishka Sethia, CEO, CFO, and Whole Time Director, will represent the company. The call is accessible via universal dial-in numbers plus 91 22 6280 1341 and plus 91 22 7115 8242. International toll-free numbers are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. A Diamond Pass link and investor kit link are also provided for participation. The announcement was issued by Sapna Kochar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 07, 2026.
